retainedDetails.originalTitle: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers
retainedDetails.originalSummary: Many children born in Syria since the war began in 2011 have no legal identity because nationality passes only through fathers – many of whom are dead or missing – a member of the independent UN commission investigating rights violations in the country said on Wednesday.
